question: What becomes dear to yoginīs through great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation?
premises: mahā siddhiḥ is the great accomplishment
inference: The verse claims the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation makes one dear to yoginīs.
uncertainties: exact syntactic scope of mahā siddhiḥ
plain_english: Enjoyment, liberation, and great accomplishment make one dear to the yoginīs.
